name: wa-file-sender
description: Aplicación de escritorio para preparar y enviar un ZIP por contacto de WhatsApp.

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-whatsapp.cjs && install-electron && node node_modules/puppeteer/install.mjs && node scripts/prepare-browser.cjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.build:dir: node scripts/patch-whatsapp.cjs && npm run prepare:browser && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.build:windows: node scripts/check-distribution.cjs && node scripts/patch-whatsapp.cjs && npm run prepare:browser && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/check-distribution.cjs && node scripts/patch-whatsapp.cjs && npm run prepare:browser && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
